patch.summary:
Choose Livestorm only if your buying job matches “Browser-based webinar and virtual events platform for marketing teams.” rather than WhatConverts's shape. Choose WhatConverts only if your buying job matches “Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking from $30/mo ” rather than Livestorm's shape. Workflow advantage: Livestorm leans multichannel-campaigns, creator-marketing; WhatConverts leans analytics. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Livestorm is Browser-based webinar and virtual events platform for marketing teams.; WhatConverts is Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking from $30/mo with Plus/Pro/Elite ladders..
- Company-size focus: Livestorm (small-business, mid-market) vs WhatConverts (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Livestorm-leaning multichannel-campaigns, creator-marketing vs WhatConverts-leaning analytics.
- Researched limits: Livestorm — Pricing is attendee-credit based (EUR), not a simple flat SaaS ladder; WhatConverts — Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite.

Limitations — Livestorm: Pricing is attendee-credit based (EUR), not a simple flat SaaS ladder; Pro caps session length at 4 hours (12 on Enterprise); WhatConverts: Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite; Usage overages can dominate TCO.
